status.summary: Data4's page published 17 September 2026 provides the ADEME-requested data 'pour ses data centers en exploitation en France', and its linked table lists 21 colocation data centres operated by Data4 Services, all in LAU 91363 (Marcoussis): DUAL, D3, DC01 to DC12 and DC14 to DC20. The Essonne prefectoral authorisation of 31 May 2024 for DATA 4 SERVICES at route de Nozay, Marcoussis lists existing buildings D3 and DC 01 to DC 20 on parcels B 66 and B 83, so the dated operator statement covers the existing Route de Nozay campus (Data4 PAR01, Campus Paris-Saclay). It is a present-tense statement of operation as of 17 September 2026, not an opening date; the table's figures relate to operating year 2025. The authorised DC 21 to DC 23 and Data4's separate PAR02 and PAR03 sites are outside this project's scope.

locator.precision: Centroid of cadastral parcels B 66 and B 83 in Marcoussis (104.1 ha, about 1,780 by 1,309 m), the two parcels on which the 31 May 2024 authorisation places DATA 4 SERVICES' installations at route de Nozay. It locates the campus land, not any of the data-centre buildings; the point falls inside a 3,928 m2 industrial BD TOPO building.
locator.identity_review: Data4's 17 September 2026 ADEME table lists 21 colocation data centres operated by Data4 Services in Marcoussis (LAU 91363), referenced to the head-office SIRET of DATA 4 SERVICES (SIREN 493 254 643). The prefectoral authorisation of 31 May 2024 for the same company at route de Nozay, Marcoussis lists existing buildings D3 and DC 01 to DC 20 and, in article 1.2.2, places the authorised installations on parcels B 66 and B 83 only. API Carto returns 913630000B0066 and 913630000B0083 as one contiguous 104 ha polygon, close to the 110 ha Data4 gives for PAR01; its area centroid lies inside the union 329 m from the boundary. Data4's published PAR01 address point (3 Route de Marcoussis, Nozay) lies 67.5 m outside the union; the Géorisques point of DATA 4 SERVICE (AIOT 0006522360) is on parcel B 62, 174 m outside the union, and is not used; Data4's PAR02 address (15 rue Marin Angiboust) is 1.9 km away and PAR03 (7 route de Villejust, Nozay) is a different site. The union also contains the separately registered III-V Lab building and areas registered to DATA 4 SAS (SIREN 487 631 210, a Data4 group company); the commune centre is not used.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The cadastral service publishes no positional accuracy; the point is the centroid of a 104 ha campus whose vertices lie up to 1,049 m away, and the industrial buildings inside the union extend up to 675 m from it; Data4 publishes no georeferenced plan of the individual data centres.

status.summary: AT TOKYO's release dated 11 September 2026, about its ATBeX network-platform service in the Osaka zone, says that its new hosted AWS Direct Connect service can be combined with 'the Equinix OS1 location, which can already be connected from ATBeX' (すでにATBeXから接続可能なEquinix OS1拠点) to build redundant connections over different routes to two AWS locations. AT TOKYO, which provides the ATBeX connections into its own and partner data centres, is stating first-hand that Equinix OS1 is a live connection location of its platform on the release date, and the release says its information is current as of that date. This records OS1 as operating on 11 September 2026; it is not an opening date. Equinix's own OS1 page (Internet Archive copy of 3 October 2026) describes the Osaka OS1 data centre in the present tense, with 6,015 m2 of colocation space in an 11-storey building at the Nishi Shinsaibashi Building, 1-26-1 Shinmachi, Nishi-ku; that floor area is a specification, not space in use. The November 2026 ATBeX items in the release are plans and are not used.

locator.precision: GSI house-number address point for 大阪府大阪市西区新町一丁目２６番１号, the address Equinix publishes for OS1 (1-26-1, Shinmachi, Nishi-ku, Nishi Shinsaibashi Building, Osaka 550-0013). The point lies on the eastern street line of the block, about 3 m east of the outline of the building GSI's standard map draws there (about 50 m by 35 m). It marks the OS1 building's address, not a building outline, entrance or surveyed boundary.
locator.identity_review: Equinix's OS1 page (Internet Archive raw copy of 3 October 2026; equinix.com itself answers robots.txt with HTTP 403 and was not accessed) gives the address '1-26-1, Shinmachi, Nishi-ku / Nishi Shinsaibashi Building / Osaka, 550 0013'. GSI's address search returns exactly one feature for 大阪府大阪市西区新町1-26-1, the house number 新町一丁目２６番１号, at 135.495911, 34.675838, and GSI's reverse geocoder returns Osaka City Nishi-ku (27106), 新町一丁目, for the point. On GSI's z17 and z18 standard-map tiles the point sits on the eastern block line beside a large building drawn with diagonal hatching, north of the wide road shown across the tile. Equinix's page markup also carries its own map-centre value for the page's location widget, 30.8 m south of the GSI point in the same block (pyproj WGS84 geodesic); it is noted only as a cross-check and is not the locator. No commercial web map, PeeringDB or OpenStreetMap data was used. Details are in the geometry-facts file.
locator.uncertainty_reason: GSI publishes no positional accuracy for house-number address points. The point is on the street frontage at the eastern edge of the address building, which extends about 50 m west and 35 m north-south, so the data-centre space may lie up to about 60 m from the point.

status.summary: MC Digital Realty's release of 30 October 2026, issued with OPTAGE, describes in the present tense the KIX campus that MCDR operates in the Saito area of Osaka (MCDRが大阪府彩都エリアで運営するKIXキャンパス). It says the campus has 74 MW of total IT power capacity and that its four data-centre buildings all support high-power, high-density IT environments, and it names the campus members as KIX10, KIX11, KIX12, KIX13 and KIX15, with KIX15 still to open in Q4 2028. KIX10 (Digital Osaka 1) is therefore one of the four existing, operated buildings of the campus on 30 October 2026. This refreshes the record's 19 August 2026 observation, which rested on a Digital Realty facility-page version, with MCDR's own newer statement. Scope is unchanged (KIX10 existing operations); 30 October 2026 is the release date, not an opening date, and the 74 MW is design capacity, not load in service.
